description: This is a Java unit test class for the ModifyAttribute class, testing various aspects such as immutability, equality, validation of inputs, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ModifyAttribute, testing construction, immutability, JSON serialization, equality, and input validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that instances of ModifyAttribute are immutable and that involved classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations for ModifyAttribute.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAttribute
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null attribute throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null JSON pointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithEmptyJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with an empty JSON pointer throws AttributePointerInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithValidArguments
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with valid arguments succeeds.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidAttributePointer
methods.description: Expects a JsonKeyInvalidException when providing an invalid JSON pointer.

methods.name: createInstanceFromInvalidJsonValue
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance from invalid JSON value throws JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithValidJsonObjectAsValue
methods.description: Ensures successful creation when providing a valid JSON object as value.

methods.name: createInstanceWithEmptyPointer
methods.description: Verifies that an empty JSON pointer results in an AttributePointerInvalidException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method outputs the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Ensures that creating an object from valid JSON string produces correct object with expected fields.

methods.name: modifyTooLargeAttribute
methods.description: Tests that creating a ModifyAttribute with attribute data exceeding size limit throws ThingTooLargeException.
